title: Software-Defined Networking: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: An airport has one control tower guiding every plane. The planes only follow the instructions. S D N brings that idea to networks.

scenes.heading: The control tower
scenes.narration: S D N splits the brain from the muscle. The controller is the control tower, the control plane. Switches only forward, which is the data plane. Northbound A P Is connect apps to the controller. Southbound A P Is connect the controller to devices.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Routing logic moves, it doesn't vanish. REST is northbound. There are other southbound options.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. The controller is the brain, and the devices only forward. Northbound talks to apps. Southbound talks to devices. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva SDN lab.
